literal: Performing a siege, even those who have besieged, sustaining their defense, those who hold fast conquering, is a fortress.
translation: A true fortress is one that enables its defenders, holding fast to their stronghold, to defeat even those who have laid a complete siege against them.
modern: முற்றுகையிட்டுப் போரிடும் பகைவர்களையும், தங்களுக்குரிய பற்றுக் கோட்டை விடாமல் காக்கும் கோட்டைவாசிகள் வெல்ல உதவுவதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate military value of a fortress. A true fort (அரண்) is not just a passive barrier, but an active tactical advantage that allows the defenders (பற்றியார்) who hold onto their stronghold (பற்று ஆற்றி) to overcome and defeat even a powerful enemy army that has completely surrounded and besieged them (முற்று ஆற்றி முற்றியவரையும்). The word 'முற்று' refers to a complete encirclement or siege, while 'பற்று' represents the defensive grip or the stronghold itself. The couplet highlights that a fort's design must empower a smaller, defending force to triumph over a besieging force.
